title: Current-source owner/lifecycle regression after D20 default-route promotion

diagnosis.initial_observation: The first current-source D17 run was 13/16. D17A02, D17A03 and D17A06 still assumed an imported neutral visible rig, but the current D20 bridge intentionally installs the Formal Humanoid consumer by default.
diagnosis.root_cause: The failures were stale test assumptions about the visible presentation route, not a Unity runtime crash or a missing D20 installation.
diagnosis.test_change: D17ActionQualityPlayModeTests now branches on the installed D20 presentation consumer. The D20 branch asserts a registered adapter, candidate renderer ownership, hidden fallback renderers, action consumption, Swimming/Fish support and successful Humanoid pose application. The old quarantine assertions remain for a genuinely non-D20 route.
invariants_retained: D2 FormalAnimatorReady remains false for the procedural D2 controller
D2 visualRoot/physical-root owner and lifecycle contracts remain asserted
Single visible consumer and hidden old fallback renderers remain asserted
Boarding, swimming and safe-disembark state consumption remain asserted
No test was changed to unconditional pass or skipped

status_boundary: Q02 is PASS_WITHIN_SCOPE for current D2 owner/lifecycle and route-aware D17 regression. It does not prove authored action quality, natural swimming, native foreground keyboard focus, hand/helm contact, no-clipping, vegetation grounding, screenshots or target-device performance.
